title: Unimodular Bicyclic Graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a simple undirected graph with adjacency matrix $A(G)$. A graph $G$ is said to be \emph{unimodular} if $\det A(G)\in\{-1,1\}$. A connected graph with $m$ vertices and $m+k-1$ edges is called \emph{$k$-cyclic}; in particular, a bicyclic graph has $m$ vertices and $m+1$ edges. Unimodular unicyclic graphs have been completely characterized. In this paper, we investigate the corresponding problem for bicyclic graphs.
